'''2007 Ohio State Championship Brad Eier LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brad Eier]] at [[2007 Ohio State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' B. Eier
* '''Deck name:''' Noob Beater
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
